description: This PHP source file defines the PayGradeDao class, which provides data access methods for handling PayGrade and related entities such as PayGradeCurrency and CurrencyType within the OrangeHRM system. It includes CRUD operations, search and filter functions, and query building for pay grades and currencies.

classes.name: PayGradeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for retrieving and manipulating PayGrade and related entities in the database.

methods.name: getPayGradeById
methods.description: Fetches a PayGrade entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingPayGradeIds
methods.description: Retrieves existing pay grade IDs from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getPayGradeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PayGrade entities matching the provided search filters.

methods.name: getPayGradesPaginator
methods.description: Builds a Paginator for paginated retrieval of pay grades based on search filters.

methods.name: getCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Gets a list of PayGradeCurrency entities associated with a specific pay grade ID.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginated query for PayGradeCurrency entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PayGradeCurrency entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Counts the number of PayGradeCurrency entities matching the search filters.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches a PayGradeCurrency entity for a specific currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: getPayPeriods
methods.description: Retrieves all PayPeriod entities, ordered by name.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves all CurrencyType entities, ordered by name.

methods.name: getCurrencyById
methods.description: Finds a CurrencyType entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCurrencyIdsForPayGradeId
methods.description: Retrieves existing currency IDs associated with a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradesCount
methods.description: Counts the number of pay grades matching search filter criteria.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Persists a PayGrade entity to the database.

methods.name: savePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Persists a PayGradeCurrency entity to the database.

methods.name: deletePayGrades
methods.description: Deletes multiple PayGrade entities by their IDs.

methods.name: deletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Deletes specified PayGradeCurrency entities for a pay grade.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves allowed currencies for a specific pay grade, with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Counts allowed currencies for a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator for currencies allowed for a given pay grade.
